## Executive Summary

Kavusik Rosan is a **final year** Computer Science Engineering student at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology (2023-2027), **HCL GUVI Campus Ambassador**, and privacy engineer specializing in **adversarial machine learning** and **AI-resistant security systems**. 

**Creator of Obscura Arcanum** — an advanced anti-AI image protection system shortlisted among the top 100 nationally for AICTE APF 2025 and Yukti Challenge 2025. This platform combats unauthorized AI exploitation using adversarial ML with encryption.

**Key Focus Areas**: Privacy Engineering, Adversarial ML, Cybersecurity, AI Defense Systems

## Projects

### 1. Obscura Arcanum
**Anti-AI Image Protection System**

Shortlisted among top 100 nationally (AICTE APF 2025 & Yukti Challenge 2025). Advanced media protection platform using adversarial machine learning with encryption to combat unauthorized AI exploitation.

- **Technologies**: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, Cryptography libraries
- **Features**: 
  - Adversarial perturbations for image obfuscation
  - Multi-layer encryption
  - Privacy-first architecture
  - AI-resistant image transformation
- **Impact**: Protects digital content from AI scraping and unauthorized training
- **Status**: Active development, nationally recognized
- **Recognition**: AICTE APF 2025, Yukti Challenge 2025

### 2. Virtual Navigator
**Real-time Hand-Gesture Navigation System**

Computer vision system that interprets hand movements for controlling applications without physical touch. Advanced gesture recognition for accessibility and hands-free interaction.

- **Technologies**: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Computer Vision
- **Features**: 
  - Real-time gesture recognition
  - Touchless navigation interface
  - Multi-gesture support
  - Low-latency processing
- **Use Cases**: 
  - Accessibility for differently-abled users
  - Hands-free control in sterile environments
  - Interactive presentations and demos
  - Gaming and entertainment

### 3. Autoform Assist
**AI-Powered Form Auto-Fill Mobile App**

Mobile application that automatically fills forms using OCR and NLP for faster, more accurate submissions. Reduces manual data entry time and improves user experience.

- **Technologies**: Mobile (React Native/Flutter), Python backend, OpenCV, TensorFlow
- **Features**:
  - Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
  - Natural Language Processing
  - Smart form field detection
  - Auto-fill suggestions
- **Use Cases**: 
  - Government form submission
  - Insurance applications
  - Job applications
  - Data collection

### 4. DeepLynk
**Android Safety & Security App**

Android application that scans links and media before opening to block hidden trackers, advertisements, and phishing attempts.

- **Technologies**: Android, Security APIs, Link analysis
- **Features**: Real-time threat detection, tracker blocking, phishing prevention
- **Impact**: Enhanced mobile browsing security

### 5. Link Shift
**Serverless Encrypted P2P Platform**

End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer messaging and file transfer using direct WebRTC device-to-device connections.

- **Technologies**: WebRTC, Encryption, P2P networking
- **Features**: Serverless architecture, E2E encryption, direct device connection
- **Privacy**: No server storage, complete privacy

### 6. Obscura Dravion
**Biometric Intelligence System**

Rapid video archive search system with integrated privacy safeguards for biometric data.

- **Technologies**: Biometrics, Computer Vision, Video processing
- **Features**: Fast search, privacy protection, intelligent indexing
- **Applications**: Security, surveillance, archive management
